en: Crowed with celestials, Rishis Gandharvas, Suparnas, Nagas, Asuras and Siddhas, filled with the celestials perfumes, scattered over with celestials flowers, resounding with the kettle drums and the deep hum of infinite voices and echoing with the softer music of the flute, the Vina and the tabor, the cars of the celestials could scarcely find a way through the firmament.

sa: विरथं विधनुष्कं च कुरुष्वैनं यदीच्छसि। तदाचार्यवचः श्रुत्वा कर्णो वैकर्तनस्त्वरन्॥ अस्यतो लघुहस्तस्य पृषत्कैर्धनुराच्छिनत्। अश्वानस्यावधीद् भोजो गौतमः पार्णिसारथी॥
en: So if you can, deprive him of the use of his car and his bow.” Then, Vikartana's son, Karna, hearing those words of the preceptor quickly cut-off Abhimanyu's bow with his arrows, when the latter was light-handedly scattering his shafts. Then Kritavarman of the Bhoja race, slew his steeds and Kripa the son of Gautama dispatched his two flanksupporters.

sa: भग्नचक्राक्षनीडाश्च निपातितमहाध्वजाः। हताश्वाः पृथिवी जग्मुस्तत्र तत्र महारथाः॥ परिपेतुर्हयाश्चात्र केचिच्छस्त्रकृतव्रणाः। रथान् विपरिकर्षन्तो हतेषु रथयोधिषु॥
en: Mighty car-warriors, having the wheel, the axle and the terraces of their cars broken, fell down on the grounds, with their steeds slain and their long arms severed. Steeds fell down on the battle-field mangled with the cut of weapons, and car wheeled around deprived of their warriors.

sa: स्निग्धपत्रफला वृक्षा गन्धमादनसानुषु। भ्रमरारावमधुरा नलिनी: फुल्लपङ्कजाः॥ विलोड्यमानाः पश्येमाः करिभिः सकरेणुभिः। पश्येमां नलिनी चान्यां कमलोत्पलमालिनीम्॥ स्रग्धरां विग्रहवती साक्षाच्छ्रियमिवापराम्। नानाकुसुमगन्धाढ्यास्तस्येमाः काननोत्तमे॥ उपगीयमाना भ्रमरै राजन्ते वनराजयः। पश्य भीम शुभान् देशान् देवाक्रीडान् समन्ततः॥८३।
en: On the plateau of the Gandhamadana all the trees are furnished with glossy foliage and fruits. Look! how these lotus-lakes decked with full blown lotuses and sweet with the hum of black fees are being agitated by elephants with their mates! look at another lotus lake decked with an array of lotuses and looking like a second Sree in very flesh and blood with a garland encircling her neck. In this excellent forest, there are ranges of woods rich with the fragrance of various flowers and ringing with the hum of the black fees. O Bhima, behold on all sides the auspicious sporting grounds of the gods!

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यो नः संख्ये नौरिव पारनेता जेता रिपूणां राजपुत्रस्तरस्वी। अनर्हता लोकवीरेण तेन दीव्याम्यहं शकुने फाल्गुनेन॥
en: Yudhisthira said He who takes us like a boat to the other shore of the sea of battle, who is ever victorious over foes, who is endued with great activity and who is the only one hero in this world (in Arjuna). With that Falguni as stake, O Shakuni, though he does not deserve it, I shall (now) play.

sa: सोष्ट्रिका भरतश्रेष्ठ सभेरीपणवानका। सतोमराङ्कुशा राजन् सशतघ्नीकलाङ्गला॥ सभुशुण्ड्यश्मगुडका सायुधा सपरश्वधा। लोहचर्मवती चापि साग्निः सगुडशृङ्गिका॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O king, with deer-skin vessels (for carrying water), with trumpets, taboos and drums, with lances and forks and Sataghnis, with plough-shares. With rockets, stones, battle-axes and other weapons, with shields protected by iron, with engines for hurling balls and bullets and fires.

sa: नलं नामारिदमनं दमयन्त्याः प्रियं पतिम्। निघधानामधिपतिं दृष्टवानसि मे प्रियम्॥ एकवस्त्रार्धसंवीतं सुकुमारतनुत्वचम्। व्यसनेनार्दितं वीरमरण्यमिदमागतम्॥
en: Have you seen the dear-loved husband of Damayanti, my best beloved one, by name Nala, the king of the Nishadhas, the subduer of his foes, wearing half a piece of cloth, of delicate body and skin and that warrior who, crushed under calamity, has repaired into this forest?

sa: तवार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमभिप्रपन्नो यथैव कृष्णः सह यादवैस्तैः। तथैव चाहं नरदेववर्य यमौ च वीरौ कृतिनौ प्रयोगे॥
en: And, O king, as Krishna together with the Yadavas is eager for your welfare so am I. The twins also are brave and skilled in arms, (And) we, whose chief object consists in the advancement of your wealth and prosperity, encountering your enemies in battle, will kill them."

sa: सिन्धुवारांस्तथोदारान् मन्मथस्येव तोमरान्। सुवर्णवर्णकुसुमान् गिरीणां शिखरेषु च॥ कर्णिकारान् विकसितान् कर्णपूरानिवोत्तमान्। तथापश्यन् कुरबकान् वनराजिषु पुष्पितान्॥ कामवश्यौत्सुक्यकरान् कामस्येव शरोत्करान्। तथैव वनराजीनामुदारान् रचितानिव॥ विराजमानांस्तेऽपश्यस्तिलकांस्तिलकानिव। तथानङ्गशराकारान् सहकारान् मनोरमान्॥ अपश्यन् भ्रमरारावान् मञ्जरीभिर्विराजितान्। हिरण्यसदृशैः पुष्पैर्दावाग्निसदृशैरपि॥ लोहितैरञ्जनाभैश्च वैदूर्यसदृशैरपि। अतीव वृक्षा राजन्ते पुष्पिता: शैलसानुषु॥
en: On the summits of the mountains they saw the graceful Sindoofar trees looking like the arrows of Cupid and the blossoming and gold coloured Karnikaras appearing like ear-rings of excellent workmanship. And in the woods of the Gandhamadana they beheld the blossoming Kurubakas appearing like the shafts of Cupid and making the lustful persons more and more amorous. They beheld also the Tilaka trees appearing like beauty-spots painted on the forehead of the forest. They beheld further the beautiful Shahakaras (mango trees) have the efficacy of Cupid's darts, graced with blossoms and hummed over by black bees. There grew several trees on the plateau of the mountains; some of which bearing flowers of a golden hue, some, of the colour resembling forest conflagration, some red, some green and some

sa: ततः प्रभग्ना सहसा महाचमू: सा पाण्डवी तेन नराधिपेन। दिशश्चतस्रः सहसा विधाविता गजेन्द्रवेगं तमपारयन्ती॥
en: Agitated by that animal, the hostile army looked life-less. Unable to stand in battle, they then fled away in great fear, crushing one another. Then the huge army of the Pandavas, routed by king Shalya, suddenly fled on all sides unable to stand the vigor of that elephant.

sa: नासीदहो न रात्रिरासीन्न सदासीन्नासदासीत् तम एव पुरस्तादभवद् विश्वरूपम्। सा विश्वरूपस्य रजनी हि एवमस्यार्थोऽनुभाष्या॥
en: The Shruti declares,-Day was not. Night was not. Aught was not. Naught was not. In the beginning there was only Ignorance. She was of the form of the universe, and she is the night of Narayana of universal form. This is the meaning of the word of Tamas.

sa: मामध्वरे शंसितारः स्तुवन्ति रथन्तरं सामगाश्चोपगान्ति। मां ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मविदो यजन्ते ममाध्वर्यवः कल्पयन्ते च भागम्॥
en: It is to me that the chaunters offer their praises in Sacrifices. It is to me that the Samansingers sing their Rathantaras. It is to me that Brahmanas knowing the Vedas celebrate their Sacrifices. And it is to me that the Addharyus offer the shares of sacrificial offerings.

sa: प्रीतिर्न भवत्यसुहृद्गणैः। जित्वा त्वद्य वरारोहां दमयन्तीमनिन्दिताम्॥ कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि सा हि मे नित्यशो हृदि।
en: To play at dicc with those that are not my relatives, gives me no pleasure. Having this day obtained the hand of Damayanti, who is most beautiful and possessed of blameless features, I shall think myself very lucky, for she is, as ever, the darling of my heart.”

sa: शूद्रो राजन्भवति ब्रह्मबन्धु १श्चारित्रो यश्च धर्मादपेतः। वृषलीपतिः पिशुनो नर्तनश्च राजप्रेष्यो यश्च भवेद् विकर्मा॥
en: That wretch of a Brahmana, who neglects to satisfy his duties and whose conduct becomes wicked becomes, O king, a Shudra. The Brahmana, who marries a Shudra woman, who becomes vile in conduct or a dancer or a village servant or performs other unbecoming acts, becomes a Shudra.

sa: अकस्माच्चाभिकामोऽसि सीतां राक्षसपुङ्गव॥ ऐश्वर्यस्य विनाशाय देहस्य स्वजनस्य च। अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टां तां रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते।२०॥ सीतां धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम्। वसुधाया हि वसुधां श्रियाः श्रीं भर्तृवत्सलाम्॥
en: O foremost of Rākşasas-0 you of a vicious understanding, for the destruction of your wealth yourself and your relatives, you did suddenly cherish amour for Sitā, greater than-Yeven) Arundhati and Rohiņi. Forsooth you did perpetrated an unbecoming deed by distressing the adorable Sitā ever devoted to her lord, an earth* even to Earth herself and a Śrī (Śrt is the goddess of wealth and good fortune-but Sitā is more fortunate than fortune herself-) even to Śrī herself. *The Earth is an emblem of patience but Sítā is more patient than the earth.

sa: तदेकवासःसंवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च। सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तय॑माना मुहुर्मुहुः॥ राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा॥ अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमोदये। रावणाद् विनिवृत्तार्था मर्दव्यकृतनिश्चया॥
en: And I saw her in that garden, wearing a single piece of cloth soiled with dirt, surrounded by the Rākşasīs and remonstrated with now and then by those ugly demons. Having a single braid of hair, poorly, engaged in thoughts touching her lord, she was lying on the earth shorn of all grace like to a lotus on the appearance of the winter. She had not the least attachment for Rāvana and was resolved upon putting an end to her existence.

sa: अभिद्रुत्य तु राधेयः पाण्डुपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥ वज्रच्छत्रांकुशैर्मतस्यैर्ध्वजकूर्मम्बुजादिभिः। लक्षणैरुपपन्नेन पाण्डुना पाण्डुनन्दनम्॥ पवित्रीकर्तुमात्मानं स्कन्धे संस्पृश्य पाणिना। ग्रहीतुमिच्छन् स बलात् कुन्तीवाक्यं च सोऽस्मरत्॥
en: It seemed at the time when Karna, the son of Radha was chasing Yudhishthira as if he is intended to catch him forcibly so as to touch him on should with his fair colour hand having lucky marks as thunderbolt, umbrella, goad, fish, flag, tortoise and lotus etc. in order to attain purity. In the meantime, a memory of commitment he had made once before Kunti, chained his racing feet.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुरुपयातो महाद्युतिः। शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा जगत्पतिः॥ वैनतेयं समारुह्य भास्करस्तोयदं यथा। तप्तहाटककेयूरो वन्द्यमानः सुरोत्तमैः॥ ब्रह्मणा च समागत्य तत्र तस्थौ समाहितः।
en: At this juncture, that lord of the universe, the highly-eifulgent Visnu, clad in yellow apparel, and bearing in his hands the conch, the discus, and the mace, and adorned with burnished Keyūras, (A bracelet worn on the upper arm.) arrived there, riding Vinatā's son; like to the Sun riding the clouds. And worshipped by the foremost of the celestials, he drew near Brahmā, and sat down with a collected mind.

sa: महत्त्वमृषिमुख्यत्वं ददामि तव कौशिक। ब्रह्मणस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः॥ प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच पितामहम्। ब्रह्मर्षिशब्दमतुलं स्वार्चितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः॥ यदि मे भगवन्नाह ततोऽहं विजितेन्द्रियः।
en: Hearing Brahma's speech, the anchorite Viśvāmitra bowing down thus answered the Grandsire with clasped hands, The incomparable title of Brahmarși is to be won by one by performing sterling works. And since you have not addressed me (by that title), it appears that I have not yet succeeded in subduing my senses. *The text is very faulty. The literal meaning would be, since you have not.....I have subdued my senses, which would be absurd. I have therefore rendered the passage freely.

sa: विगाढे रजनीमध्ये शक्रप्रह्लादयोरिव। ततो घटोत्कचो बाणैर्दशभिौणिमाहवे॥ जधानोरसि संक्रुद्धः कालज्वलनसंनिभैः। स तैरभ्यायतैर्विद्धो राक्षसेन महाबलः॥ चचाल समरे द्रौणिवार्तनुन्न इव दुमः। स मोहमनुसम्प्राप्तो ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः॥
en: During that pitchy-dark night, like that (which had taken place) between Shakra and Prahada (in days of yore). Then, in that engagement, Ghatotkacha, inflamed with wrath, struck the son of Drona in the chest with ten arrows resembling the Yuga fire. The son of Drona, endued with great strength (thus) deeply pierced in that encounter by the Rakshasa, became (greatly) afflicted and trembled like a tree shaken by the wind. Leaning against his flag-staff (for support), he fell into a swoon.

sa: कामक्रोधौ च लोभश्च परस्येाविकत्थना। कामक्रोधौ वशे कृत्वा ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः ॥ विक्रम्य घोरे तपसि ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। कालाकाङ्क्षी चरेल्लोकान् निरपाय इवात्मवान्॥
en: They follow the path of lust, anger, cupidity, envy of others, and boastfulness. Overcoming lust and anger, practising the vow of Brahmacharya and becoming a complete master of his senses, the Brahman practising patiently the austerest penances, and observing the most rigid restraints, should live in this world, calmly waiting for his time like one seeming to have a body through fully knowing that he is not subject to destruction.

sa: तेषां वचनं श्रुत्वा तुष्टुवुस्तां महानदीम्। मोक्षार्थं रक्षसां तेषामूचुः प्रयतमानसाः॥ क्षुतं कीटावपन्नं च यचोच्छिष्टाचितं भवेत्। सुकेशमवधूतं च रुदितोपहतं च यत्॥
en: Hearing these words of theirs, those ascetics lauded the great river. For the rescue of those Rakshasas, with contracted minds those ascetics said-"The food over which one will sneeze, that in which there are worms and insects, that which may be mixed with refuges of food, that which is mixed with hair, that which is trampled. That which is mixed with tears shall make up the food of these Rakshasas!'

sa: अथ प्रायात् पुनरन्य आगच्छदश्वार्थी ब्राह्मणस्तमब्रवीदतियातो दास्यामि त्वरितमेव त्वरितमेव मे दीयतामित्यब्रवीद् ब्राह्मणस्तस्मै दत्त्वाचं रथधुरं गृहणता व्याहृतं ब्राह्मणानां साम्प्रतं नास्ति किंचिदिति॥
en: When proceeding, another man desirous of getting a horse, also came to him. He said to the Brahmana, "On my return I shall give (you the horse).” But the Brahmana said, "Give it to me without delay.” He gave the Brahmana the only horse he had. He, then himself seizing the yoke of the car, began to drag it. He said, “There is now nothing (to give) to the Brahmanas."

sa: अथ काले बहुतिथे वने महति दारुणे। तडागं सर्वतोभद्रं पद्मसौगन्धिकं महत्॥ ददृशुर्वणिजो रम्यं प्रभूतयवसेन्धनम्। बहुपुष्पफलोपेतं नानापक्षिनिषेवितम्॥ निर्मलस्वादुसलिलं मनोहारि सुशीतलम्। सुपरिश्रान्तवाहास्ते निवेशाय मनो दधुः॥
en: Thus many days passed over, when the merchants saw in the midst of that fearful and extensive forest a very large lake, which was all-beautiful, pregnant with lotuses, most delight-some, containing abundant grasses and fuels and also various sorts of delicious fruits and flowers (on its banks) and inhabited by several kinds of birds; and also finding the water of the lake to be pure and tasteful, most charming and cool, these tired traverllers made up their mind up stop there.

sa: असक्तः पद्मपत्रस्थो जलबिन्दुर्यथाचलः॥ निर्मुक्तस्य रजोरूपान्नापराधो भवेन्मम। यथा हि शून्यां पथिकः सभामध्यावसेत् पथि॥ तथाद्यावासयिष्यामि गुरुपत्न्याः कलेवरम् एवमेव शरीरेऽस्या निवत्स्यामि समाहितः॥
en: If I be free from the touch of passion, I cannot incur any sin by doing what I wish to do. As a traveller, in course of his sojourn, takes up his quarters (for a while) in any empty house he finds, I shall, similarly live, this day within the body of my preceptor's lady. Indeed, with mind rapt up in Yoga, I shall live today in this lady's body.

sa: गोभिश्च समनुज्ञात: सर्वत्र च महीयते। यस्त्वेतेनैव कल्पेन गां वनेष्वनुगच्छति॥ तृणगोमयपर्णाशी निःस्पृहो नियतः शुचिः। अकामं तेन वस्तव्यं मुदितेन शतक्रतो॥ मम लोके सुरैः सार्धे लोके यत्रापि चेच्छति॥
en: Indeed, such a man permitted by kine, lives honoured in every region of happiness. That man who follows kine every day in the forest with this intention, himself living the while on grass and cowdung and leaves of trees, his heart freed from desire of fruit, his senses controlled from every improper object, and his mind purified that man, O you of a hundred sacrifices, lives happily freed from the control of desire in my region or in any other region of happiness that he wishes, in the company of the celestials.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शुल्कमन्येन दत्तं स्याद् ददानीत्याह चापरः। बलादन्यः प्रभाषेत धनमन्यः प्रदर्शयेत्॥ पाणिग्रहीता चान्य: स्यात् कस्य भार्या पितामह। तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान्।॥
en: Yudhishthira said Desirous of marriage some one actually gives a dower to the girl's kinsmen; some one, the girl's kinsmen consenting, promises to give a present; some one says, I shall carry away the girl by force; some one simply shows his riches; some one, again, actually takes the hand of the girl with rites of marriage. I ask you, O grandfather, whose wife does the girl actually become? You are the eye to those who wish to know the truth.

sa: न हि ज्यां संस्पृशानस्य तलने वाऽपि गृह्णतः॥ पुमानाधिरथेः स्थातुं कश्चित् प्रमुखतोऽर्हति। अपि स्यान्मेदिनी हीना सोमसूर्यप्रभांशुभिः॥ न वधः पुरुषेन्द्रस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः।
en: While that son of Atiratha had touched the bow-string and put on his fences, surely there was no person, who could be bold enough to stand up in his front. Indeed, the earth might be deprived of the splendour of the Moon and the rays of the Sun; but the slaughter of the lord of men who did never turn away from the field could not be possible in battle.

sa: अन्योन्यमेवं शप्त्वा वै तस्थतस्तत्र सौ तदा। अथ सोऽपि नृयो विप्रान् पानाच्छादनभोजनैः॥ पुत्रकामः परं शक्त्या यत्नाच्चोपाचरच्छुचिः। तस्य प्रसन्नाविप्रेन्दाः कदाचित् पुत्रमीप्सवः॥ तपःस्वाध्यायनिरता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः। सहिता नारदं प्राहुर्देह्यस्मै पुत्रमीप्सितम्॥
en: Thus having cursed each other those two sages continued to live there. Meanwhile Srinjaya, desirous of obtaining a son and purifying himself, began to gratify the Vipras to the best of his resources, with drinks, garments and foods. After a while, those Brahmanas devoted to the study of the Vedas and acquainted with the contents of the scriptures and their various auxiliaries, being gratified with the king, who desired to have a son, came in a body to Narada and said to him-"Give this king a son of the sort he desires."

sa: निकृन्तन्तमनीकानि शरदंष्ट्र मनस्विनम्। चापव्यात्ताननं घोरमसिजिह्व दुरासदम्॥ अनर्ह पुरुषव्याघ्रं ह्रीमन्तमपराजितम्। पातयामास कौन्तेयः कथं तमजितं युधि॥ उग्रधन्वानमुग्रेषु वर्तमानं रथोत्तमे। परेषामुत्तमाङ्गानि प्रचिन्वन्तमथेषुभिः॥ पाण्डवानां महत् सैन्यं यं दृष्ट्वोद्यतमाहवे। कालाग्निमिव दुर्धर्षं समचेष्टत नित्यशः॥
en: How did Kunti's son overthrow in battle that unconquerable one, that fearful bowman scattering fearful arrows, and cutting off the enemies, heads, that invincible hero, modest in every thing, that foremost of all men, stationed on his chariot that hero, having arrows for his teeth, with bow for his wide open mouth, with the terrible sword for his tongue; how was be overthrown, who was never vanquished before and who did not deserve such a fate, that warrior who was as irresistible as the fire of dissolution and seeing whom in battle the great army of the Pandavas were ever filled with terror?

sa: स मन्त्रकाले सम्मन्त्र्य सर्वां नैःश्रेयसी क्रियाम्। सुयोधनमिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद् राजसंसदि॥
en: Then in that time suitable for consultations, he consulted with them about the best remedial measure (against Arjuna's vow). And then repairing to the assembly of kings he said these words to Suyodhana.

sa: परिरक्ष्य स सेनां ते दशरात्रमनीकहा। जगामास्तमिवादित्यः कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Alas (even that great Bhishma) the slayer of hostile heroes after having protected your army for ten nights and having achieved feats exceedingly difficult to be accomplished, today has set like the sun.

sa: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान् गुणान्। कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु॥
en: Self, dwelling in Nature (having a material body), enjoys the qualities that are born in Nature. The cause of the birth in good or in evil works is its connection with such qualities.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रप्रियकरं मयि विस्मृतसौहृदम्। पापं बालवधे हेतुं श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता जयद्रथम्॥
en: Tomorrow will I slay Jayadratha who forgetting his friendship for me, has been doing good to the sons of Dhritarashtra and who has become instrumental in bringing about the slaughter of my boy.

sa: शून्याऽऽसीत् पृथिवी सर्वा वृद्धबालावशेषिता। निरश्वपुरुषेवासीद् रथकुञ्जरवर्जिता॥
en: The whole earth was empty for only the children and the old remained in their houses, others having joined the Kuru armies.

sa: स तथा कुरुशोणाश्व यथा मुच्येत सैन्धवः। मम चार्तप्रलापानां मा कुधः पाहि सैन्धवम्॥
en: O you owning crimson steeds, do you so manage that the ruler of the Sindhus may yet be saved. Be not angry with me for all these raving of mine afflicted as I am with grief. Oh! save, save the ruler of the Sindhus!

sa: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते। ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य धिष्ठितम्॥
en: Who is the light of all luminous bodies, who is beyond all darkness; who is knowledge, the object of knowledge and the end of knowledge; who is seated in the hearts of all.

sa: नियन्तुः शिल्पयत्नाभ्यां प्रेरितोऽरिशरार्दितः। परिचिक्षेप तान् नागः स रिपून् सव्यदक्षिणम्॥
en: Urged on by the skill and vigour of its rider and smitten with the shafts of the enemy. That clephant began to throw down right and left, the warriors of the hostile host.

sa: प्राणोऽपानः समानश्च रामे राज्यं प्रशासति। पर्यदीष्यन्त तेजांसि तदानश्च नाभवन्॥
en: When Rama ruled his dominions, the vital breaths known as Prana and Apana and Samana and others, all duly performed their functions. All splendour appeared to increase and evil portents were never seen.

sa: तस्मिन् प्रथमसंग्रामे भीमज्यातलनिःस्वने। तावकानां परेषां च नासीत् कश्चित् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: son In the first encounter that resounded with the terrible twang of the bow and flapping of the leather fences, none of your party or of that of the enemy turned them back.

sa: प्रयातु नो भवानग्रे देवानामिव पावकिः। अनुयास्यामहे त्वाजौ सौरभेया इवर्षभम्॥
en: Like the son of Pavaka proceeding before the celestials, do you proceed at the head of this our army; we will follow you in battle like a heard of bulls following the leader.

sa: अथ कोसलराजस्तु विरथः खड्गचर्मभृत्। इयेष फाल्गुनेः कायाच्छिरो हतु सकुण्डलम्॥
en: Thercupon deprived of the use of his bar the king of the Kosalas grasping his sword and shield. Strove to take off the head, graced with ear-rings, of Phalguna's son, from his trunk

sa: दारुणः क्षत्रधर्मोऽयं विहितो धर्मकर्तृभिः। यत्र राज्येप्सवः शूरा बाले शस्त्रमपातयन्॥
en: Heartless, indeed, are the duties of the Kshatriyas as specified by the law-givers, in as much as these duties even enjoin a hero, desirous of sovereignty, to shoot weapons at a mere child.

sa: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिौनी संतुष्टो येन केनचित्। अनिकेत: स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान् मे प्रियो नरः॥
en: He is dear to Me who is taciturn, who is contented with anything that come to him, who is homeless, steady-minded, full of faith, and to whom censure and praise are the same.

sa: गर्भाद्धि जहतुर्देवावश्विनौ भिषजां वरी। तं दृष्ट्वा पितुरुत्सङ्गे शयानं देववर्चसम्॥
en: The two foremost of celestials physicians, the twin Asvins drew out the child from the kings womb. Then beholding the new-born babe of divine radiance lie on the lap of his father. one

sa: सिंहनादेन महता नरसिंहो धनंजयः। गजानीकममित्राणामभीतो व्यधमच्छरैः॥
en: That foremost of men, Dhananjaya sending up a fierce war-cry, fell to agitate that elephant division of his enemy, with his shafts.

sa: तानश्वमेधे राजेन्द्रो ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽददत् पिता। शतं शतं रथगजा एकैकं पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः॥
en: That foremost of kings, their father gave them away to the Brahmanas as sacrificial peasants, at his own sacrifice. Each of those princes was followed by hundreds upon hundreds of car-warriors and elephants.

sa: परमास्त्राणि धुन्वानाः सौभद्रमभिदुद्रुवुः। तान् निवार्यार्जुनिर्वाणैः क्राथपुत्रमथार्दयत्॥
en: Rushed at Subhadra's son, discharging numerous weapons of celestial make. Beating back all of them with arrows, Arjuna's son afflicted Kratha's son,

sa: पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा तथा चक्रुः स्म कौरवाः। उपायेनापयानं ते घटोत्कचमयार्दिताः॥
en: Hearing these words of the grandsire, and afflicted as they were with the fear of Ghatotkacha, they (the Kauravas) delightedly did what the former said availing themselves of the pretest advent of night.

sa: तुम्बुरु रदश्चैव विश्वावसुर्हहा हुहूः। अभिगम्यामरश्रेष्ठांस्तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तवैः॥
en: Tamburu, and Narada, Vishvavasu and the Hahas and the Huhus went there and adored the foremost of the celestial with various hymns.

sa: सखगाः साङ्गुलित्राणाः सपट्टिशपरश्वधाः। अदृश्यन्त भुजाश्छिन्ना हेमाभरणभूषिताः॥
en: Then severed arms were seen on the field with fingers-protectors and grasping swords, lances, axes and bludgeons and adorned with golden ornaments.

sa: तामुद्यतामभिप्रेक्ष्य वङ्गानामधिपस्त्वरन्। कुञ्जरं गिरिसंकाशं राक्षसं प्रत्यचोदयत्॥
en: Beholding that lance raised, the ruler of the Bangas, speedily urged his elephant of proportions huge like a hill, against the Rakshasa.

sa: तमयस्मयवर्माणमिषुणा दूरपातिना। विव्याध दि सौभद्रः स पपात व्यसुः क्षितौ॥
en: Him cased in iron male, the son of Subhadra pierced on the breast with an arrows capable of flying to a great distance; and he fell down on the earth deprived of life.

sa: राधेयोऽहं कुरुश्रेष्ठ नित्यमक्षिगतस्तव। द्वेष्योऽहं तव सर्वत्र इति चैनमुवाच ह॥
en: "I am Radha's son, O foremost of the Kurus, who whenever he became the object of your sight, looked upon with enmity by ." These were the words he then addressed to Bhishma.

sa: अपश्यंस्तेजसां राशिं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्। सोऽब्रवीत् स्वागतं देवा ब्रूत किं करवाण्यहम्॥
en: And there, beheld that heap of energy, who resembled in radiance a million of suns. (Seeing the gods come) Mahadeva said, "All hail O god! speak what am I to do for you!

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महेष्वासः सप्तभल्लैः सुतेजनैः। धनूंषि तेषामाच्छिद्य ननर्द पृतनापतिः॥
en: The great archer and army commander Shankha furiated on this. He shot seven bhalla arrows duly sharpened which cut-off the bows of those seven chariot holders. He then challenged them for another attack.

sa: शोकसम्मूढहृदयो दुःखेनाभिपरिप्लुतः। मज्जमान इवागाधे विपुले शोकसागरे॥
en: With a heart confounded with grief and overwhelmed with affliction and like one sinking in an extensive and deep sea of sorrow.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन सात्यकिः परवीरहा। तथेत्युक्त्वागमत् तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thus spoken to by Pritha's son, Satyaki the slayer of hostile heroes, saying 'yea' to the words of the former, returned to that part of the field where Yudhishthira was. on Or on

sa: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते। एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः॥
en: The Bright and the Dark, these two paths are considered to be eternal paths in this world. By the one, one goes never to return, by the other, one goes to come back.

sa: तस्य लाघवमार्गस्थमलातसदृशप्रभम्। दिशः पर्यपतच्चापं गाण्डीवमिव घोषवत्॥
en: His bow, sending forth sound like the twang of Gandiva while stretched and restretched, seemed to revolve like a circle of fire.

sa: सप्तद्वीपां वसुमती मारीचोऽगृह्णत द्विजः। रामं प्रोवाच निर्गच्छ वसुधातो ममाज्ञया॥
en: The earth with her seven grand divisions were bestowed by him upon the twice-born son of Maricha (Kasyapa). Then the the latter addressed Rama saying-"Go you out of this Earth, at my command".

sa: मस्तं जगामाथ सहस्ररश्मिः। ततो बलानां श्रमकर्शितानां मनोऽवहारं प्रति सम्बभूव॥
en: While he was thus crushing the Pandava troops, the sun of thousand rays went below the horizon. Then the hearts, of all those warriors exhausted with fatigue, yearned for the order of withdrawal.

sa: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीब्रह्मचारिखते स्थितः। मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्ते आसीत मत्परः॥
en: With his self in tranquility, freed from fcar, adhering to the practices of Brahmacharies, he should restrain his mind, fix his heart on Me and sit down, regarding Me as his final goal.

sa: नानाविधानि शस्त्राणि विसृजन्तो महारथाः। अन्योन्यमभिधावन्तः सम्प्रहारार्थमुद्यताः॥
en: Mighty car-warriors, putting forth all their energies rushed to smite down one another, hurling at the same time weapons of various kinds.

sa: मानहा भव शत्रूणां मित्राणां नन्दिवर्धनः। कौरवाणां भव गतिर्यथा विष्णुर्दिवौकसाम्॥
en: May you be the humiliator of the pride of your enemies, and may you be the enhancer of the delight of your friends, the Kauravas, as Vishnu is of the denizens of heaven.

sa: उपदिष्टो हि मे पित्रा योगोऽनीकविशातने। नोत्सहे हि विनिर्गन्तुमहं कस्यांचिदापदि॥
en: My father has taught me the way to penetrate this kind of array. But I do not know how to come out of the array, if per chance some danger overtake me there.

sa: धनुर्भिरृष्टिभिः खङ्गैर्गदाभिः शक्तितोमरैः। योधाः प्रहरणैः शुभैस्तेष्वनीकेष्ववस्थिताः॥
en: Then the warriors armed with bows, swords, scimitars, maces, javelins, lances, and shining weapons of various kinds took up their respective positions.

sa: पश्य माधव सैन्यानि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संयुगे। व्यूढानि व्यूहविदुषा गाङ्गेयेन महात्मना॥
en: "Behold, O Madhava, the troops of the sons of Dhritarashtra formed in battle array by the high-souled son of Ganga, who is versed in all the modes of forming soldiers in battle array,

sa: तत्राकरोद् रथोपस्थाशून्याशान्तनवोबहून्॥ तत्राद्भुतं महच्चक्रे शरैराछंद् रथोत्तमान्।
en: The son of Shantanu made many cars empty, for that foremost of all car-warriors cut off many heads by showering his arrows.

sa: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे। आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते॥
en: Others offer up all the actions of the senses, and those of the life-breaths, into the Yoga-fire of self-restraint, kindled by knowledge.

sa: दिव्यबुद्धिप्रदीपेन युक्तस्त्वं ज्ञानचक्षुषा। प्रभावात् तस्य विप्रर्व्यासस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: Through the grace of that immeasurably powerful Rishi Vyasa, you now possess the lamp of celestial vision and the eye of knowledge.

sa: कुरु कार्याणि सर्वाणि धर्मिष्ठोऽसि नरर्षभ॥ बाहुवीर्येण पृथिवीं लब्वा भरतसत्तम।
en: Do all these acts, and then will you be called a righteous man, O best among the men; O best among the Bharatas, having won this earth by the prowess if your arms,

sa: को हि तिष्ठति दुर्धर्षे द्रोणे शस्त्रभृतां वरे। सेनापतिः स्यादन्योऽस्माच्छुकाङ्गिरसदर्शनात्॥
en: When the indomitable Drona, who is foremost among those conversant with Brahma and is equal to Shuka and Angirasa in learning, is here, who else is worthy of being selected as a leader?

sa: सर्वोद्योगेन महता धनंजयमुपाद्रवत्। त्रिगर्ताधिपतेरर्थे जीवितस्य विशाम्पते।॥
en: Assaulted Dhananjaya putting forth all his energies, desirous of saving, o ruler of men, the life of the king of the Trigaretas.

sa: तेषामथ द्रोणधनुर्विमुक्ताः पतत्रिणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खाः। भित्त्वा शरीराणि गजाश्वयूनां जग्मुर्महीं शोणितदिग्धवाजाः॥
en: Then numerous arrows shot from the bow of Drona and adorned with golden wings, piercing through the bodies of elephants and young steeds, stuck themselves on the ground, with feathers crimson with blood.

sa: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिोगे त्विमां शृणु। बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि॥
en: The knowledge now imparted to you is relating to Sankha (the mystery of knowing Self). Now listen to Yoga, (the mystery of living in Self, which, if well possessed, O Partha, cuts off Karmabandhana (the law of rebirths, resulting from the effects of actions).

sa: ऊरुग्राहगृहीताश्च नाभ्यधावन्त पाण्डवान्॥ अवध्ये शन्तनोः पुत्रे हते भीष्मे महौजसि।
en: They could not then rush against the Pandavas as if their thighs were locked and seized in a vice. When that unslayable son of Shantanu. viz., Bhishma endued with great prowess was overthrown,

sa: सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञः पिता देवव्रतस्तव। समानीय महीपालानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Your father Devavrata learned in the rules of war duly calling all the kings before him thus spoke to them these words.

sa: शृङ्गाभ्यां भीमसेनश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। रथैरनेकसाहौस्तथा हयपदातिभिः॥
en: In its two horns was placed Bhimasena and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki, supported by many thousands of car-warriors and cavalry and infantry.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतर्षभ। हिरण्यवर्मा राजेन्द्र रोषादार्ति जगाम ह॥
en: After the lapse of a few days, O best of the race of Bharata, on hearing of this fact (Shikhandin bearing himself like a male), Hiranyavarman, O great king, was afflicted with anger.

sa: ऋते प्रायगतं राजन्न्यस्तशस्त्रमचेतनम्। हन्यान्मां युधि योधानां सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O king, except when I shall be prepared for death, having abandoned my and withdrawing myself from all surrounding sights, none will be able to kill me. What I tell you in true.

sa: अथाभिषिषिचुर्दोणं दुर्योधनमुखा नृपाः। सैनापत्ये यथा स्कन्दं पुरा शक्रमुखाः सुराः॥
en: As in days of yore, the gods with Indra at their head, invested Skanda with their leadership, so now did the monarchs headed by Duryodhana, invest Drona with the command of the troops.

sa: बभ्रमुः कुञ्जराश्चात्र शरैर्विद्धा निरङ्कुशाः। अश्वाश्च पर्यधावन्त हतारोहा दिशो दश॥
en: Pierced with shafts and deprived of their riders who used to guide them with hooks, elephants began to course (madly) through the field steeds ran about in all direction having their riders slain.

sa: विनिःसृत्य महोल्काभिस्तिमिरं सर्वतोदिशम्। अन्योन्यमुपतिष्ठद्भिस्तत्र चोक्तं महर्षिभिः॥
en: Men with lighted torches in their hands will meet great difficulty to meet together, for a thick gloom will cover all space.

sa: शरदंष्ट्रो धनुर्वक्त्रः खङ्गजिह्वो दुरासदः। नरसिंहः पिता तेऽद्य पाञ्चाल्येन निपातितः॥
en: That invincible warrior who had arrows for his feet, the bow for his mouth and the sword for his tongue, that best of men, has today been killed by the prince of Panchala.

sa: महाभूताधिपतये रुद्राणां पतये तथा। आदित्यपतये चैव वसूनां पतये तथा॥
en: Do you bow to Him who is the Supreme Lord of all creatures, who is the Lord of the Rudras, who is the Lord of the Adityas, and of the Vasus as well.

sa: नास्ति सांख्यसमं ज्ञानं नास्ति योगसमं बलम्। तावुभावेकचर्यो तावुभावनिधनौ स्मृतौ॥
en: There is no Knowledge like that of the Sankhyas. There is no power like that of Yoga. These two prescribe the same practices, and both are considered as capable of leading to Liberation.

sa: एतान् गुणांस्तु क्षेत्रज्ञो भुङ्क्ते नैभिः स भुज्यते। निर्गुणो गुणभुक् चैव गुणस्रष्टा गुणाधिकः॥
en: The Individual Soul, called Kshetrajna, enjoys and suffers the action of these three qualities. He, however, is above them and they cannot touch Him. Freed from these qualities, He is again their enjoyer and sufferer. Having created them Himself, He is above them all.

sa: महांश्चैवाग्रजो नित्यमेतत् क्षरनिदर्शनम्। कथितं ते महाराज यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: The Very Being called Mahan who is the first born is always spoken of as an instance of the Destructible. I have now told you, O king, all that you had asked me.

sa: यः कालयवनः ख्यातो गर्गतेजोऽभिसंवृतः॥ भविष्यति वधस्तस्य मत्त एव द्विजोत्तम।
en: I shall next, O foremost of Brahmanas, bring about the death of Kalayavana, a Danava who will be endued with great power on account of his being equipt with the energy of Gargya.

sa: इत्युक्तो जाजलिर्भूतैर्जगाम विमनास्तदा। वाराणस्यां तुलाधारं समासाद्याब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Thus addressed by those beings, Jajali went onwards with a depressed heart. Arrived at Baranasi he met Tuladhara whom he addressed thus.

sa: किं यज्ञविधिरेवैष किमेतज्जप्यमुच्यते। एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि मे मतः॥
en: Or, it such a man to be considered as following the ordinances of (mental) sacrifices? How is the path of the Reciters to be called? You posses universal knowledge. Tell me all this.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच युधिष्ठिरं धर्मनिधि पुरुहूतपिवेश्वरः। उपमन्युर्मयि प्राह तपन्निव दिवाकरः॥ अशुभैः पापकर्माणो ये नराः कलुषीकृतः। ईशानं न प्रपद्यन्ते तमोराजसवृत्तयः॥
en: Vasudeva said Upamanyu, who appeared to shine like the sun, said to me Those sinful men who are sullied with impious deeds, do not succeed in attaining to Ishana. Having their nature sullied by the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance they can never approach the Supreme Deity. It is only those twiceborn persons who are of purified souls that succeed in attaining to the Supreme Deity.

sa: दान्तानामपि यो दान्तो धीमतामपि या च धीः। देवानामपि यो देव ऋषीणामपि यस्त्वृषिः॥
en: To him, who is regarded as the most restrained of all creatures who are restrained, and him who is the intelligence of all creatures gifted with intelligence; to him who is regarded as the god of all gods, and the Rishi of all Rishis.

sa: धात्रा परोपकाराय स साधुरिव निर्मितः॥ अथाभवत् क्षणेनैव वियद् विमलतारकम्।
en: It was the refuge of numberless birds seeking shade and shelter, as if it were placed there by the Creator for the behoof of all creatures like a good man in the world.

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु मे त्वमिदं सूक्ष्म सांख्यानां विदितात्मनाम्। विहितं यतिभिः सर्वैः कपिलादिभिरीश्वरैः॥
en: Bhishma said Hear now what the subtile principles are of the followers of the Sankhya doctrine all of whom have a clear knowledge of the soul. Those principles have been laid down by all the great and powerful Yatis having Kapila for their first.

sa: मानान्मोहाच्च लोभाच्च लौल्यमेतत्प्रकल्पितम्। विष्णुमेवाभिजानन्ति सर्वयज्ञेषु ब्राह्मणाः॥
en: The hankering after these originates from pride, error of judgement, and cupidity. The Brahmanas realise the presence of Vishnu in every sacrifice.

sa: सोऽभिगम्य पितुः पादावगृह्णादरणीसुतः। यथोपजोषं तैश्चापि समागच्छन्महामुनिः॥
en: Born on the fire-sticks, Shuka approaching his father, touched his feet. With due formalities he then accosted the disciples of his father.

sa: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयाभिनिवृत्तं विद्धि ज्ञानगुणं मनः। प्रज्ञाकरणसंयुक्तं ततो बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते॥
en: Pure Knowledge, exists in the various objects of knowledge. Know that mind is only an attribute of Knowledge. When the mind is united with the faculties of knowledge, then the understanding sets in.

sa: ततस्त्रिलोककृद् देवः पुनरेव महातपाः। अप:संचिन्तयामास ध्यातास्ताश्चाप्यथागमन्॥
en: The illustrious Creator of the three worlds, gifted with great ascetic merit, then thought of the Waters which immediately came to him.

sa: एवं सोमे तथा वायौ भूम्याकाशशरीरगः। सरागस्तत्र वसति गुणांस्तेषां समाचरन्॥
en: He is equally affected if he goes to Soma, or Vayu, or Earth, or Space. The fact is, he lives in all these, with attachment, and shows the attributes peculiar to those regions.

sa: भ्रातृणां नास्ति सौभ्रात्रं येष्वेकस्य पितुः सुताः। राज्यहेतोर्विवदिताः कश्यपस्य सुरासुराः॥
en: As regards you princes, you are the children of the royal sage Bhangasvana. These others are the children of an ascetic. The gods and the Asuras are children of even one common father.

sa: भूर्वायुः सलिलाग्निश्च खं वाग्बुद्धिः स्थितिर्मतिः। कर्म सत्यानृते चोभे त्वमेवास्ति च नास्ति च॥
en: You are Earth, you are Wind, you are Water, you are Agni, you are Ether, you are Speech, you are the Understanding, you are Steadiness, you are Intelligence, you are the Acts, you are Truth, you are Untruth, you are existent, you are nonexistent.

sa: तदेतदुपशान्तेन बोद्धव्यं शुचिकर्मणा। योगदोषान् समुच्छिद्य पञ्च यान् कवयो विदुः॥
en: This last is acquired by those who are of pure acts and endued with tranquillity of soul, the means being the subjugation of those five obstacles of Yoga of which the learned speak.

sa: न चान्नदोषान् निन्देत न गुणानभिपूजयेत्। शय्यासने विविक्ते च नित्यमेवाभिपूजयेत्॥
en: He should never find fault with the food put before him, nor should he speak highly of its merits. He should seek a bed and a seat that are removed from human habitations.

sa: पुरा मृत: प्रणीयते यमस्य राजशासनात्। त्वमन्तकाय दारुणैः प्रयत्नमार्जवे कुरु॥
en: Soon after death you are sure to be taken before Yama at his behest. For acquiring happiness in the next world, try to acquire virtue by the practice of difficult and austere vows.

sa: योगात्मकेनोशनसा रुद्ध्वा मम हृतं वसु। योगेनात्मगतं कृत्वा निःसृतश्च महातपाः॥
en: He said Ushanas, having spiritualised himself by Yoga, entered my body and depriving myself of liberty, has taken away all my riches. Having by Yoga entered my body he has again left it.

sa: त्यक्त्वा यः प्राकृतं कर्म नित्यमात्मरतिर्मुनिः। सर्वभूतात्मभूस्तस्मात् स गच्छेदुत्तमां गतिम्॥
en: That person who renounces all ordinary acts, practises penances, devotes himself to Study the Soul, taking a delight in it, and regards himself as the Soul of all creatures, acquires a supreme end.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच यद्याग्निमारुतौ भूमिः खमापश्च शरीरिषु। जीव: किंलक्षणस्तत्रेत्येतदाचक्ष्व मेऽनघ॥
en: Bharadwaja said If in the bodies of all living creatures there are heat, wind, earth, space, and water, what then are the sins of the living agent? Tell me these, O sinless one.

sa: ययातिनहुषाच्चापि पूरुस्तस्माच्च लब्धवान्॥ अमूर्तरयसस्तस्मात्ततो भूमिशयो नृपः।
en: Nahusha gave it to Yayati, and Yayati to Puru. Puru gave it to Amurttaraya. From Amurttaraya it went to the royal Bhumishaya.

sa: वृणीष्व च वरं विप्र मत्तस्त्वं यदिहेच्छसि। प्रसन्नोऽहं तवायेह विश्वमूर्तिरिहाव्ययः॥
en: O Brahmana, do you ask of me the boons you wish! I am pleased with you to-day and I appear to you now in my universal form as freed from decay and deterioration!

sa: वृषाकपिरुवाच अहं हि पितरः स्रष्टुमुद्यतो लोककृत् स्वयम्। यस्य चिन्तयतः सद्यः पितृकार्यविधीन् परान्॥
en: I am the Creator of the worlds. I ain determined to create those that are to be called departed manes.-Saying these words, he began to think of those high ordinances that should regulate the rites to be performed in honour of the departed manes.

sa: ततः समारभत् कर्म दैवं पित्र्यं च भारत। आहूय देवानिन्द्रादीन् भागं भागं विधिक्रमात्॥
en: He then, O Bharata, began to perform the ceremonies in honour of the gods and the departed manes, by dividing that Charu into as many parts as were necessary, according to the injunctions of the scriptures, and by invoking the gods headed by Indra.

sa: एषामेकैकेशोऽर्थानां सौम्यादीनां स्वलक्षणम्। शृणु संसार्यमाणानां पदार्थपदवाक्यतः॥
en: Listen now to the characteristics of these requirements beginning with ambiguity, one after another, as I explain them according to the combinations.

sa: सत्त्वस्थः सात्त्विकान् भावाशुद्धान् पश्यति संश्रितः। स देही विमलः श्रीमाश्रद्धाविद्यासमन्वितः॥
en: That person, however, who endued with faith and scriptural knowledge, follows the quality of Goodness, attends only to all good things and becomes endued with beauty and a soul free froin every corruption.

sa: ऋषीणां देवतानां च सदा भवति विग्रहः। कस्य वाचा ह्यदैवं स्याद्यतो दैवं प्रवर्तते॥
en: There is a constant rivalry between the gods and the Rishis, and if they all have to go through their Karma, still it can never be said that there is no such thing as Destiny, for it is the latter that introduces all Karma.

sa: ततस्तदर्थं यतते कर्म चारभते महत्। इष्टानां रूपगन्धानामभ्यासं स चिकीर्षति॥
en: One then, for the sake of that object, trics and begins acts that require much labour. One tries his best for enjoying again and again those forms and scents that appear very sweet.

sa: स तया छन्द्यमानोऽन्यैरीप्सितैर्नृपकन्यया। नान्यमात्मप्रदानात् स तस्या ववे वरं द्विजः॥
en: Though tempted by the princess witi, offers of various other things, the Brahmana, however, did not seek the Brahmana, however, did not seek any thing else than the offer of her own person.

sa: अथ वैश्रवणं प्रीतो भगवान् प्रत्यभाषत। अर्चितोऽस्मि यथान्यायं गमिष्यामि धनेश्वर।॥
en: Thus addressed by king Vaishravana, the illustrious Ashtavakra, replied to him, with a pleased heart, saying I have been duly honoured by you. I desire now, O Lord of Riches, to go hence.

sa: ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं तथैवोक्तं यथातथम्। व्यथितं वह्निवद् राजन् ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत्॥ अस्माकं ब्रह्मवध्यायाः कोऽन्तो लोकपितामह। दैवेनाभिहतानस्मान् न पुनर्हन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Addressed by him, the trees and herbs and grasses became as much moved as Agni had been at the command and they replied to the Grandfather, saying, How shall we, O grandfather of all the worlds, be ourselves saved from this sin? You should not afflict us that have already been assailed by the fates.

sa: स त्वमेवंविधो दान्तः क्षत्रिय: प्रियबान्धवः। प्रजा भृत्यांश्च पुत्रांश्च स्वधर्मेणानुपालय॥
en: Do you, then, become a Kshatriya of this kind! Do you restrain your senses, be kind to your friends, and cherish, according to the duties of your order, your subjects, servants, and children.

sa: क्लेशाः परिनिवर्तन्ते केषाञ्चिदसमीक्षिताः। स्वं स्वं च पुनरन्येषां न किंचिदधिगम्यते।॥
en: Some men are seen whose calamities vanish before even these are seen by them. Others there are who are seen to possess no riches but who are free from misery of every sort.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यथान्यायं त्वया तात प्रश्नः पृष्टः सुसंकटः। बुधानामपि सम्मोहः प्रश्नेऽस्मिन् भरतर्षभ॥
en: Bhishma said “However difficult it may be to answer it, the question which you have asked, O son, is proper. Verily, the question is of such a nature that even the highly learned men become stupefied in answering it, O chief of Bharata's racc.

sa: तदर्थवदिदं वाक्यमुपेतं वाक्यसम्पदा। अविक्षिप्तमना राजन्नेकाग्रः श्रोतुमर्हसि॥
en: You should, therefore, O king, hear with rapt attention these words of mine, fraught with meaning and endued with wealth of sound.

sa: जाजले तीर्थमात्मैव मा स्म देशातिथिर्भव। एतानीदृशकान् धर्मानाचरनिह जाजले।॥ कारणैर्धर्मन्विच्छन् स लोकानाप्नुते शुभान्।
en: O Jajali, the Soul is itself a sacred shrine. Do not roam about on the Earth for visiting sacred places! A person, by following these duties and by seeking to acquire merit according to his own ability, undoubtedly succeeds in getting blessed regions hereafter.

sa: इच्छन्तस्ते विहाराय सुखं महदवाप्नुयुः॥ उत जाताः सुनक्षत्रे सुतिथौ सुमुहूर्तजाः। यज्ञदानप्रजेहायां यतन्ते शक्तिपूर्वकम्॥
en: They who are born under an auspicious constellation on an auspicious lunation and at an auspicious hour, try their best for performing sacrifices, practising charity, and procreating children, and wishing to pass their time cheerfully in those acts, at last acquire very great happiness.

sa: तद्भक्तस्तद्गतो नित्यं तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः। भज पुत्र महादेवं ततः प्राप्स्यसि चेप्सितम्॥
en: He plays on various musical instruments. He is a vocalist. He has a hundred thousand eyes. He has one mouth, he has two mouths, he has three mouths, and he has many mouths.

sa: सोऽथ सौम्येन मनसा देवानुचरमन्तिके। प्रत्यपश्यज्जलधरं कुण्डधारमवस्थितम्॥
en: While thinking thus with a cool mind, he saw stationed before him that retainer of the gods, viz., the Cloud called Kundadhara.

sa: वन्दनीयाश्च वरदा वयमप्यनुयायिनः। मनुष्याणां विशेषेण नावेक्ष्या इति मे मतिः॥
en: They derseve to be adored. They are capable of granting boons. Indeed, we too deserve to be followed by others. I tell you, O lady, that we cannot be seen by human beings.

sa: ब्राह्मणांश्चैव मन्येत गुरूंश्चाप्यभिपूजयेत्। सर्वभूतानुलोमश्च मृदुशील: प्रियंवदः॥
en: One should respect the Brahmanas, worship his preceptor and seniors, show mercy to all creatures, be of mild disposition and sweet speech.

sa: श्वपच उवाच नैवात्सहे भवतो दातुमेतां नोपेक्षितुं ह्रियमाणं स्वमन्नम्। उभौ स्यावः पापलोकावलिप्तौ दाता चाहं ब्राह्मणस्त्वं प्रतीच्छन्॥
en: The Chandala said I dare not present this piece of meat to you, nor can I quietly allow you to rob me of my own food. If I give you this meat and if you take it, yourself being a Brahmana, both of us will go down to regions of misery in the next world.

sa: जनन्यास्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा तदाप्रभृति शत्रुहन्। मम भक्तिर्महादेवे नैष्ठिकी समपद्यत॥
en: Devoting yourself to him, fixing your heart upon him, depending upon him, and accepting him as your one refuge, do you, O son, worship Mahadeva and then all your wishes will bear fruits!

sa: पृथुस्तूत्पादयामास धनुराधमरिंदमः। तेनेयं पृथिवी दुग्धा सस्यानि सुबहून्यपि। धर्मेण च यथापूर्वं वैन्येन परिरक्षिता॥
en: Regarding the bow, again, O chastiser of enemies, it was Prithu who first created it. It was with the help of this weapon that that son of Vena, while he ruled the Earth virtuously for many years, milked her profusely of crops and grain.

sa: द्वापरे मैथुनो धर्मः प्रजानामभवन्नृप। तथा कलियुगे राजन् द्वन्द्वमापेदिरे जनाः॥
en: It was in the next cycle, viz., Dvapara, that the practice of sexual intercourse originated, O king, amongmen. In the Kali age, O monarch, men have come to marry and live in pairs.

sa: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः। रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते॥
en: Desire for the object of the senses does not affect a person who has no such desire. Desire, leaves him who has seen his soul, which, of course, is entirely free from desire.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं पराशरसुतः : प्रभुः। उक्त्वा पुत्रमधीष्वेति व्योमगङ्गामगात् तदा॥
en: Having said these words, the powerful son of Parashara ordered his son to go on with his Vedic recitation. He then left that place for plugging into the waters of the celestial Ganga."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समाप्तवचने तस्मिन्नर्थशास्त्रविशारदः। पार्थो धर्मार्थतत्त्वज्ञो जगौ वाक्यं प्रचोदितः॥
en: After Vidura had finished his say, Pritha's son Arjuna, well-skilled in the science of Profit, and conversant also with the truths of both Virtue and Profit, urged urged on (by Yudhishthira's question), said.

sa: एतान् समागतान् सर्वान् पञ्च शिष्यान् दमान्वितान्॥२० शौचाचारसमायुक्ताञ्जिक्रोधाञ्जितेन्द्रियान्। वेदानध्यापयामास महाभारतपञ्चमान्॥
en: We, five in all, endued with self-control and purity of observances, had completely mastered anger and controlled our senses. Our preceptor used to teach us the Vedas having the Mahabharata for their fifth.

sa: वेदवादाश्च निर्वृत्ताः शान्ता ब्रह्मण्यवस्थिताः। सांख्ययोगौ तु यावुक्तौ मुनिभिः समदर्शिभिः॥
en: Indeed, the two paths pointed out by sages bent on acquiring what is for their well-being viz., Vedanta and Yoga, are such that they are both concerned and again unconcerned (with silent recitations).

sa: स तु पवनसुतो निहत्य शत्रून् क्षतजवहाः सरितश्च संविकीर्य। रिपुवधजनितश्रमो महात्मा मुदमगमत्कपिभिः सुपूज्यमानः॥
en: That high-souled offspring of the Wind-god, having slain his foes, and come under the influence of fatigue incident to his slaughtering his enemies, having caused rivers of gore to flow (in the field), experienced the excess of joy on being honoured of the monkeys.

sa: मही कृता पर्वतराजिपूर्णा शैलाः कृता वृक्षवितानपूर्णाः। वृक्षाः कृताः पुष्पवितानपूर्णाः पुष्पं कृतं केसरपत्रपूर्णम्॥
en: The place in the car designed as the seat of the many, was filled with rows of hills,* Composed of gold and gems. Its hills were filled with trees; its trees were filled flowers; and (finally) its flowers were filled with leaves and filaments.

sa: सोऽमरावतिसंकाशां हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम्। प्रविवेश पुरी ब्रह्मा इन्द्रस्येवामरावतीम्॥
en: Like to Brahma entering Indra's Amaravati, he entered the city resembling the capital of Indr and filled with delighted and plump citizens.

sa: अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत्समागमः। तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्गमः।॥
en: And wonderful and astonishing was their meeting. And the concourse at that place of the monkey-forces was like the concourse of locusts.

sa: आत्मप्रशंसिनं दुष्टं धृष्टं विपरिधावकम्॥ सर्वत्रोत्सृष्टदण्डं च लोकः सत्कुरुते नरम्।
en: The person' that is self-laudatory, wicked and badly-bold, publish his own praise and met out chastisement everywhere, is honoured in the world. 1. The word, however, is naram (ac.), man. 2. i.e. indiscriminately.

sa: पूर्वकात्प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तो विश्वस्तया तया। द्रष्टमिच्छामि भर्तारमिति पर्याकुलेक्षणा॥
en: I was told by her, confident of her previous trust, with profuse tears in her eyes, “I wish to see my husband."

sa: कुम्भकर्म समीक्ष्यैव वितत्रास प्रजापतिः। कुम्भकर्णमथाश्वस्तः स्वयंभूरिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing Kumbhkarņa, Prajāpati* was seized with exceeding great fear. And then pacifying Kumbhakarma, the Self-sprung addressed him, saying. *Lit. lord of creatures.

sa: तमुत्पतन्तं त्रिशिरास्त्रिभिर्बाणैरजिह्मगैः॥ घोरैर्हरिपतेः पुत्रं ललाटेऽभिजघान ह।
en: As he sprang up, Triśiras hit at the temples of the son of the king of monkeys with three straight-speeding terrific shafts.

sa: ततस्त्वदर्शयन्सर्वान्भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान्बहून्। वराहान्महिषांश्चैव बभक्ष स महाबलः॥
en: Then they pointed to him all those heaps of edibles, various and profuse, bears and buffaloes, and that powerful (Raksasa) fell to.

sa: रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जितकाशिनः। पादपैरर्दयन्वीरा वानराः परवाहिनीम्॥
en: Hearing Rāma's words,* the heroic monkeys inspired with intrepidity, fiercely fell on the foe with trees. *Namely, "that is an uplifted engine.”

sa: इति ब्रुवाणो हनुमान्सायुधैर्हरिभिर्वृतः। अभ्यधावत्सुसंक्रुद्धो राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं प्रति॥
en: Saying this Hanuman, accompanied by monkeys armed with weapons, and excited with ire, proceeded towards the son of the lord or Raksasas.

sa: त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्। भर्तारमुपसंगम्य विहरस्व यथासुखम्॥
en: Do you spend happily your days with our lord-Rāvaņa, the Rākşasa chief, who makes his own the treasures of the three worlds.

sa: स मुष्टिनिर्भिननिमग्नवक्षा ज्वाला वमशोणितदिग्धगात्रः। नरान्तको भूमितले पपात यथाचलो वज्रनिपातभग्नः॥
en: Thereat, with his breast riven and broken down, vomiting flames and having his body bathed in blood, Narāntaka dropped down to the earth, like a hill shattered by the impetus of the thunder-bolt.

sa: अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव प्रतियातुमिवाहसि। सत्त्वहीनं मया राजरावणोऽभिभविष्यति॥
en: Do you, O Sugrīva, this very moment retrace your steps. Bereft of your strength through me you will be worsted by Rāvaņa.

sa: लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितौ वीरौ महाबलशरासनौ। अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुर्वीरौ विशिखैीमविक्रमौ॥
en: And those heroes-Lakşmaņa and Indrajitequipped with exceedingly powerful bows, and endowed with heroism and dreadful prowess, wounded each other with sharp arrows.

sa: पुष्पितैः शोभिता लङ्का वनैश्चित्ररथोपमैः। नानापतगसंघुष्टफलपुष्पोपगैः शुभैः॥
en: Larikā is embellished with groves resembling Citraratha, fair, and eloquent with the notes of various birds, and fraught with fruits and flowers.

sa: लोकक्षयकरं भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम्। निबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम्॥
en: I see a mighty fear present, destructive of people, and boding destruction to the foremost heroes among the bears, monkeys and Rākşasas.

sa: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरियूथपम्॥ वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: Seeing that monkey-leader intent upon leaping up, and surcharged with energy, with his person enlarged, Janaka's daughter, with a tearful countenance, spake in woe-begone guise, her accents choked with the vapour of grief,

sa: शोकस्यास्य कथं पारं राघवोऽधिगमिष्यति। प्लवमानः परिक्रान्तो हतनौः सागरे यथा॥
en: I do not know when shall Rāghava get at the other end of the ocean of grief, by displaying his prowess, like to one, swimming across the ocean when the boat is sunk.

sa: अट्टहासान्विमुञ्चन्तो घननादसमस्वनाः। वाश्यन्त्यश्च शिवास्तत्र दारुणं घोरदर्शनाः॥
en: And jackals of terrific forms, having voices resembling the roaring of clouds, bursting out into a horse-laugh, began to emit cries frightfully.

sa: बभूवुस्तेन घोषेण संहृष्टा हरियूथपाः। अमृष्यमाणास्तद्धोषं विनेदुर्घोषवत्तरम्॥
en: At those sounds, the leaders of monkey-bands were delighted beyond measure, and, resenting the same, set up cries louder than those sounds.

sa: स तु पवनसुतो निहत्य शत्रून् क्षतजवहाः सरितश्च संविकीर्य। रिपुवधजनितश्रमो महात्मा मुदमगमत्कपिभिः सुपूज्यमानः॥
en: That high-souled offspring of the Wind-god, having slain his foes, and come under the influence of fatigue incident to his slaughtering his enemies, having caused rivers of gore to flow (in the field), experienced the excess of joy on being honoured of the monkeys.

sa: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु। नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानां नचिराच्छ्रोष्यसे स्वनम्॥
en: You shall soon bear the roaring of the leading monkeys on the summit of mount Malaya, resembling the muttering of the clouds.

sa: अलंकारविदश्चैता नार्यः पद्मनिभेक्षणाः। उपस्थितास्त्वां विधिवत्स्नापयिष्यन्ति राघव॥
en: Here are present women having eyes like lotuses and conversant with the are of decking, Let them perform their duty, O Rāghava.

sa: स्तथाप्सरोनृत्यबिभूषितालयः। गभस्तिभिः सूर्य इवावभासयन् पितुः समीपं प्रययौ स वित्तपः॥
en: And hymned by hosts of deities and Gandharvas, having his mansion graced with the dancing of Apsarās, and floating on rays like the sun himself, that ruler of riches went to his sire.

sa: यदि सत्स्यात्सतां मुख्य नासत्स्यात्तव किंचन। त्वया यदीदृशं प्राप्तं तस्मात्तन्नोपपद्यते॥
en: If, O foremost of the good, it had existed, you wouldst not have come by any misfortune. But inasmuch as you have fallen into this plight, there is no such thing as virtue.

sa: न काल: कपिराजेन्द्र वैकलव्यमवलम्बितुम्। अतिस्नेहोऽपि कालेऽसिमान्मरणायोपकल्पते॥
en: O foremost of monkey-kings, this is no time for being overcome with stupor. At this hour, even immoderate affection may lead destruction.

sa: अथोत्पपात वेगेन हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। गरुत्मानिव वेगेन जिघृक्षगुरगोत्तमम्॥
en: Hanumān the son of Maruta rose up in the welkin with velocity like to Garuņa ready to fall upon a huge serpent.

sa: हरयस्त्वपि रक्षांसि महादुममहाश्मभिः॥ विदारयन्त्यभिक्रम्य शस्त्राण्याच्छिद्य वीर्यतः।
en: And the monkeys forcibly snatching away the weapons (of the Rākşasas), began to rive the Rákşasas with mighty trees and giant crags.

sa: नह्येष हन्तुं शक्योऽद्य वरदानात्सुनिर्भयः। तद्ग्रहीष्यामहे रक्षो यत्ता भवत संयुगे॥
en: It is not possible to slay him now, for he shall not meet with death in consequence of the boon. So let us make him captive-and we should all exert to that end.

sa: मुद्गच्छमानं व्यवभासमानम्। ददर्श चन्द्रं स कपिप्रवीरः पोप्लूयमानं सरसीव हंसम्॥
en: And that heroic monkey behold the Moon possessing the sheen of a conch, and hued like milk or the lotus-stalk, arisen and afloat (in the welkin), like a swan swimming in a tank.

sa: वज्रदंष्ट्रोऽङ्गदश्चोभौ योयुध्येते परस्परम्। चेरतुः परमक्रुद्धौ हरिमत्तगजाविव॥
en: Vajradarşțra and Angada faught fiercely with each other over and over again; ranging the field like a tiger and a mad elephant.

sa: एनमापत्सु कृच्छेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च। कीर्तयन्पुरुषः कश्चित्रावसीदति राघव ॥
en: If a person recites this (hymn), he O Raghava, does not come by misfortune, when he is in peril of his life, or is ill, or in a lonely place, or in fear.

sa: न चाप्यदृष्ट्वा वैदेही विश्रुताः पुरुषर्षभ। वनं दत्तवरं दिव्यं धर्षयेयुर्वनौकसः॥
en: O best of men, they are all well-known monkeys and without espying Vaidehī they would not have engaged in the destruction of that orchard conferred on us as a gift by the celestials.

sa: हिमवान्मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः। शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तुं न शक्यो भरतानुजः॥
en: But he that could with his arms wield Himavan or Mandara or Meru or the triple world itself along with the immortals, could not (for all his strength) lift up Bharata's younger brother.

sa: माल्यवद्भुजनिर्मुक्ता शक्तिघण्टाकृतस्वना। हरेरुरसि बभ्राज मेघस्थेव शतदा॥
en: And hurled by the hand of Mālyavān, the dart resonant with bells, appeared graceful on Hari's breast like lightening embosomed in clouds.

sa: मनो हि हेतुः सर्वेषामिन्द्रियाणां प्रवर्तने। शुभाशुभास्ववस्थासु तच्च मे सुव्यवस्थिम्।॥
en: In respect of the enlistment of the senses on behalf of any course of action good or evil, it is verily mind which is the cause; and herein my mind is righteously disposed.

sa: हीनार्थस्तु समृद्धार्थ को रिपुं प्राकृतं यथा। निश्चितं जीवितत्यागे वशमानेतुमिच्छति॥
en: Who is there that, albeit weak bent on renouncing his life, wish to bring under subjection a foe that is powerful, as if he would act with reference to one that is inferior?

sa: ततः समेतावतितीक्ष्णवेगौ महाबलौ तौ रणनिर्विशङ्कौ। कपिश्च रक्षोऽधिपतेस्तनूजः सुरासुरेन्द्राविव बद्धवैरौ॥
en: Thereupon closed in conflict those two greatly powerful (heroes)gifted with swift movements and fearless in battle—the monkey, and the son of the lord of Rākṣasas, like to the lords of celestials and Asuras.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गो वालिसूनुर्महाबलः। चिक्षेप वज्रदंष्ट्राय वृक्ष भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: Thereupon Vāli's son of mighty strength and tremendous prowess, with his body covered all over with blood, hurled a free at Vajradanstra.

sa: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः शक्राशनिस्पर्शवपुः प्रकाशम् सुग्रीवमासाध्य बिभेद वेदाग्दहेरिता क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः॥
en: Even as the fierce dart discharged by Guha' had pierced Krauñca, that shaft shot by Rāvana, rushing in violence at Sugrīva possessed of a person having the touch of Sakra's thunder-bolt, pierced it.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणान्न त्वां घातयामि वरानने। वधार्हामवमानाहाँ मिथ्या प्रव्रजने रताम्॥
en: O you of fair countenance, it is for this reason, that I do not destroy you, although you, who are engaged in false asceticism, are worthy of being killed and dishonoured. do you

sa: वानरैः पातयन्तस्ते वेगिता वेगवत्तरैः। मुष्टिभिश्चरणैर्दन्तैः पादपैश्चावपोथिताः॥
en: Gift with greater impetuosity, the monkeys felled the impetuous (Raksasas) with blows, and feet and teeth; and some were slain with trees.

sa: निराशा निहते पुत्रे दत्त्वा श्राद्धमचेतना। अग्निमावेक्ष्यते नूनमपो वापि प्रवेक्ष्यति॥
en: That one bereft of her consciousness, filled with despair, after having performed his srāddha,* will doubtless enter into fire or water. *Funereal rites performed in accordance with the injunctions of the Hindu Scriptures.

sa: हेत्वर्थयुक्तं विधिवच्छ्रेयस्करमदारुणम्। विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतं हेतुमत्त्वया॥
en: You did not obey the words uttered by Vibhisana, duly and mildly, pregnant with meaning and reasoning and tending to your welfare.

sa: अहमौपयिकी भार्या तस्यैव च धरापतेः। व्रतस्नातस्य विद्येव विप्रस्य विदितात्मनः॥
en: Like the knowledge of one God monopolized by the Brāhmaṇas only, I am the spouse of that lord of earth only, cognisant of higher truths and marrying me according to the pious ceremonials.

sa: वानरैर्वध्यमानास्ते शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्य राक्षसाः। लङ्कामभिमुखाः सस्रुभ्रष्टसंज्ञाः प्रधाविताः॥
en: And assailed by the monkeys, the Raksasas, pursued (by their foes), with their senses lost, rushed towards Lankā, leaving their arms behind.

sa: असिचर्मधरा योधाः सर्वायुधधरास्ततः। राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पुरस्तात्संप्रतस्थिरे॥
en: As he coursed on, Rākşasas, bearing swords and shields, and carrying all kinds of weapons, went before the lord of the Rākşasas.

sa: हयमुच्चैःश्रवःप्रख्यं श्वेतं कनकभूषणम्। मनोजवं महाकायमारुरोह नरान्तकः॥
en: Narāntaka mounted a white steed resembling Uccaiḥśravă, caparisoned in gold, having a large frame and endowed with the velocity of the wind.

sa: समर्थेयं जनयितुं चक्रवर्तिनमात्मजम्। ब्रूहि शुल्कं द्विजश्रेष्ठ समीक्ष्य विभवं मम॥
en: I am competent to beget on her a son who will be an emperor; speak about the dowry, O foremost the twice born, having paid due regard to the state of my wealth.

sa: उत्तर उवाच तनुर्महान् सिंह इव प्रवृद्धः। स्ताम्रायताक्षः कुरुराज एषः॥
en: The one, whose complexion is like pure gold, who is of developed proportions like a huge lion, whose eyes are expansive and coppery, whose nose is high, is the king of the Kurus.

sa: सत्यमाह पृथा वाक्यं कर्ण मातृवचः कुरु। श्रेयस्ते स्यान्नरव्याघ्र सर्वमाचरतस्तथा।॥
en: O Karna, Pritha has spoken the truth; act according to the advice of your mother; then will you get benefit, O best among men, namely by acting in that way in every detail.

sa: इन्द्रत्वं त्रिषु लोकेषु प्राप्य वीर्यसमन्वितः। दाविष्टश्च दुष्टात्मा मामुवाच शतक्रतो॥
en: Having obtained the lordship of the three worlds and so being vain of his strength and being haughty the evil minded one asked me to attend on him, Operformer of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: वाजिभिः शैब्यसुग्रीवमेघपुष्पबलाहकैः। स्नातैः सम्पादयामासुः सम्पन्नैः सर्वसम्पदा॥
en: They yoked to it the horses Shaivya, Sugriva, Meghapushpa and Balahaka, after they had been bathed and attired in all their harness.

sa: द्वाविमौ ग्रसते भूमिः सर्पो बिलशयानिवा राजानं चाविरोद्धारं ब्राह्मणं चाप्रवासिनम्।।५३
en: The earth devours these two, as a serpent destroys living in holes viz., a king who is not a warrior and a Brahmana who has never been away form home (to holy places).

sa: गौतम उवाच वेदाः साङ्गा मयाधीतास्तपो मे संचितं महत्। कौमारब्रह्मचर्यं च गुरवोऽग्निश्च तोषिताः॥
en: Gautama said: "I have read the Vedas together with all their branches and have laid up a great store of asceticism. I have led a life of celebacy, have gone through the Brahmacharya mode of life and have appeased the fire and my superiors.

sa: मरुतश्च सहेन्द्रेण विश्वेदेवास्तथैव च। बभूवुश्चैकरूपाणि यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्॥
en: The Maruts along with Indra as also the gods of the universe of the same form, as also Yakshas, Gandharvas and Rakshasas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथोक्तो वासुदेवेन नित्यमन्युरमर्षणः। सदश्ववत् समाधावद् बभाषे तदनन्तरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus spoken by the son of Vasudeva, the one who was ever wrathful and who was accustomed to return insults immediately woke up like a good horse and instantly said reply-

sa: कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वा देवराजमथाब्रुवन्। न स शक्यः सुदुर्धर्षो धैर्याच्चालयितुं प्रभो॥
en: Then, with the palms their hands elapsed they all said to the chief among the gods. O Lord, he, whom it is very difficult to subdue, cannot be influenced away from his purpose.

sa: रक्षसा निग्रहं प्राप्य रामस्य महिषी प्रिया। क्लिश्यमानापि सुश्रोणि राममेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: That lady of beautiful hips, the beloved queen of Rama, although she received a great calamity at the hands of the Rakshasas and was afflicted with woe, was at length reunited with Rama.

sa: दुर्योधनार्थं शकुनि ते निर्जितवान् पुरा। समयेन गतोऽरण्यं पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: In days of old, Shakuni on behalf of Duryodhana defeated (Yudhishthira) at a game of dice and it was according to a stipulation that Yudhishthira the son of Pandu went to the forest.

sa: पुरंदरोऽथ संचिन्त्य वैनतेयपराक्रमम्। विष्णुमेवाब्रवीदेनं भवानेन ददात्विति॥
en: Then Purandara, considering the strength of the son of Vinata, said to Vishnu these words-'Let it be given by your exalted self.'

sa: व्यास उवाच शिलोच्छवृत्तिर्धर्मात्मा मुद्गलः संयतेन्द्रियः। आसीद् राजन् कुरुक्षेत्रे सत्यवागनसूयकः॥
en: Vyasa said : O king, there lived in Kurukshetra a virtuous man, named Mudgala. He was truthful and free from malice. He was self-controlled. He led the Sila and Uncha modes of life.

sa: यो जानन् पापतामस्य तत्प्रज्ञामनुवर्तसे। स एष काममन्युभ्यां प्रलब्धो लोभमास्थितः॥
en: You, who know that he is of a sinful nature, follow his wisdom, and he too supported by you is fully under the influence of desire and wrath and a slave of lust.

sa: त्रैलोक्यरक्षणार्थाय महिषासुरनाशिनि। प्रसन्ना मे सुरश्रेष्ठे दयां कुरु शिवा भव॥
en: For the protection of the three worlds, you have slain the demon Mahisha (buffalo); O foremost of deities, be propitious to me; give me your grace and be the cause of my wellbeing.

sa: त्रिंशदेनं सहस्राणि रथाः काञ्चनमालिनः। सदश्वरूपसम्पन्नाः पृष्ठतोऽनुययुस्तदा।॥
en: Similarly, thirty thousand chariots trimmed with garments made of gold and best quality horses used to follow him while in Kuru country.

sa: मागधश्च जयत्सेनो जारासन्धिर्महाबलः। अक्षौहिण्यैव सैन्यस्य धर्मराजमुपागमत्॥
en: And Jayatsena of great strength, son of Jarasandh, king of Magadha, came to the virtuous king with an army counting an Akshauhini.

sa: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि स्नातकानां महात्मनाम्। उपजीवन्ति राजानमेनं सुचरितव्रतम्॥
en: This great resolute had employed as much as eighty eight thousand learned graduates (Snatakas) and he used to consult with them daily.

sa: तथैव पाण्ड्यो राजेन्द्र सागरानूपवासिभिः। वृतो बहुविधैर्योधैर्युधिष्ठिरमुपागमत्॥
en: In the same way, Pandya, O chief among kings, came to Yudhishthira surrounded by many warriors who had colonized along the sea.

sa: आध्वर्यवं च ते कृष्ण क्रतावस्मिन् भविष्यति। होता चैवात्र वीभत्सुः संनद्धः स कपिध्वजः॥
en: o Krishna, when the sacrifice is performed, you will also be the Adhvaryu; and in this Vibhatsu, that hero who has the figure of a monkey on his banner, clad in a coat of mail will be the Hotri (the guide in giving offerings).

sa: यः सर्वभूतप्रशमे निविष्टः सत्यो मृदुर्मानकृच्छुद्धभावः। अतीव स ज्ञायते ज्ञातिमध्ये महामणिर्जात्य इव प्रसन्नः॥
en: He, who is engaged in doing good to all creatures, who is attached to truth, not haughty, of a good mind and not a miser, is known very well among his cousins like a gem of the purest ray obtained from a good mine.

sa: कीचकश्चाप्यलंकृत्य यथाकाममुपागमत्। तां वेलां नर्तनागारं पाञ्चालीसंगमाशया॥
en: Having adorned himself to his liking, Kichaka arrived at the dancing hall at the appointed hour with a view to meet Panchali.

sa: सुकेशी सुस्तनी श्यामा पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा। तेन तेनैव सम्पन्ना काश्मीरीव तुरङ्गमी॥
en: You are one of beautiful tresses, good breasts and possessed of high graces; and plump are your buttock and breasts. Being furnished with all these beautiful signs, you appear like a Kashmirean woman.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततस्तां भर्तृशोकार्ता दीनां मलिनवाससम्। मणिशेषाभ्यलङ्कारां रुदतीं च पतिव्रताम्॥ राक्षसीभिरुपास्यन्ती समासीनां शिलातले। रावणः कामबाणातॊ ददर्शोपससर्प च॥ देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षकिम्पुरुषैर्युधि। अजितोऽशोकवनिकां ययौ कन्दर्पपीडितः॥
en: Markandeya said : Then, Ravana, smarting under the shafts of Cupid, saw Sita-afflicted with sorrow for her husband, melancholy, wearing an unclean garb, having a jewel only for her ornament, lamenting (profusely), devoted to her husband, waited upon by the Rakshasa females and seated on a stone and approached her and he, whom the gods, the demons, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas and the Kimpurushas could never conquer in battle, inflamed with lust, repaired to the Ashoka gardens.

sa: त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं रणे दक्षं शूरं कापुरुषा जनाः। अवशास्तर्पयन्ति स्म सवकामसमृद्धिभिः॥
en: Men, who are cowards being beside themselves, contribute by giving their own wealth to the fulfillment of every desire of the hero experienced in battle and who does not fight for selfish consideration.

sa: वयमाश्रयणीयाः स्म नश्रोतारः परस्य च। सान्यमासाद्य जीवन्ती परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्॥
en: We are the proper refuge to others but never depended on others ourselves. Such being the case, if I now have to live as a dependent on another, I shall sacrifice my life.

sa: शरैः संछिद्यमानानां कवचानां महात्मनाम्। ताम्रराजतलौहानां प्रादुरासीन्महास्वनः॥
en: There arose a great sound when the arrows of the high-souled Arjuna pierced the copper, silver and iron made coats of mail.

sa: हीनाङ्गं पृथिवीपालं नाभिनन्दन्ति देवताः। इति कृत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठं प्रत्यषेधन् द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: The gods do not approve of that ruler of men who has a defeat in his limbs." So saying those foremost among the twice born dissuaded that foremost among the rulers of men.

sa: ततः प्रव्यथिताङ्गोऽसौ पुत्रशोकसमन्वितः। निवारितं नृपं दृष्ट्वा देवापिः संश्रितो वनम्॥
en: Devapi, too who was defective of one limb, seeing, that ruler of men with his heart pained and struck with grief for son, dissuaded from carrying out his intentions, went to the woods.

sa: तथैवाहं मतिमता परिचिन्त्येह पाण्डुना। ज्येष्ठः प्रभ्रंशितो राज्याद्धीनाङ्क इति भारत॥
en: In the same way, myself though the eldest, was excluded from the kingdom owing to the defeat in my limbs, O Bharata, in favour of Pandu, endued with good understanding, after due reflection.

sa: वासुदेवपुरोगास्तं सर्व एवाभ्यवादयन्। विराटद्रुपदौ वृद्धावभिवाद्य हलायुधः॥
en: And all those kings with Vasudeva at their head greeting him, Halayudha too saluted Virata and Drupada and those who were aged.

sa: अजोक्षा चन्दनं वीणा आदर्शो मधुसर्पिषी। विषमौदुम्बरं शङ्खः स्वर्णनाभोऽथ रोचना॥
en: Goat, bull, sandal, flute, mirror, honey, clarified butter, iron, copper utensil, conchshells, pieces of stone (images of Vishnu) with gold within and Rochana (a pigment prepared from the urine and dung of cow).

sa: योऽस्ति यत् साम्यं त्वयि कुर्युर्विशाम्पते। बलवत्तां हि मन्यन्ते भीष्मद्रोणकृपादिभिः॥
en: The peace of the Kurus with you is therefore not expedient or desirable (they think), O lord of the universe. They think themselves strong having on their side Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and others.

sa: एतद् धर्म्यमधर्म्यं वा जन्मनैवाभ्यजायथाः। ते तु वैद्याः कुले जाता अवृत्त्या तात पीडिताः॥
en: Whether this be virtue or not, you are to practice them in consequence of this your birth; but my children, though wise and born in a high family, are without the means of earning their living and in fact they are persecuted by others.

sa: अतीव मदमत्तस्त्वं न कंचिन्नावमन्यसे। मानेन भ्रष्टः स्वर्गस्ते नाहस्त्वं पार्थिवात्मज॥
en: You are exceedingly intoxicated with vanity and there is no body you have not insulted and owing to this vanity you are no longer fit for heaven, O you born of a king.

sa: शास्त्रज्ञा देशकालज्ञास्तपोयुक्ताः क्रियान्विताः। अकृत्वा सदृशं कर्म किं शेध्वं पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Why do you, O most exalted of men, versed in the Shastras, acquainted with the rules of proper time and place, performers of religious rites, lie dead without performing acts 'worthy of you?

sa: अकस्मादेव कुप्यन्ति प्रसीदन्त्यनिमित्ततः। शीलमेतदसाधूनाम, पारिप्लवं यथा।॥
en: To be angry all on a sudden and to be generous without cause are the signs of unrighteous like clouds that inconstant.

sa: अतिभीरुमतिक्लीबं दीर्घसूत्रं प्रमादिनम्। व्यसनाद् विषयाक्रान्तं न भजन्ति नृपं प्रजाः॥
en: The king who is entirely destitute of courage, no has no spark of manliness, who is the slave of procrastination and who is addicted to sensual pleasures is never respected by his subjects.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवो भीष्मे दिव्यमस्त्रमुदीरयन्। प्रत्यगृह्णादमेयात्मा महामेघमिवाचलः॥
en: Then discharging a celestials weapon at Bhishma, Pandava, of incomparable energy, received him like a hill receiving a huge mass of cloud.

sa: संजय उवाच सहामात्यः कुशली पाण्डुपुत्रो बुभूषते यच्च तेऽग्रेऽऽत्मनोऽभूत्। निर्णिक्तधर्मार्थकरो मनस्वी बहुश्रुतो दृष्टिमाञ्छीलवांश्च॥
en: Sanjaya said With his ministers, the son of Pandu is in health; he desires that which was formerly his own, he who acquires virtue and wealth and commits no wrong deed, who is spirited, of great learning, of great fore-sight and of good behaviour.

sa: मेढीभूतः कौरवाणां त्वमद्य त्वय्याधीनं कुरुकुलमाजमीढ। पार्थान् बालान् वनबासप्रतप्तान् गोपायस्व स्वं यशस्तात रक्षन्॥
en: You are now the refuge of the sons of Kuru. The race of Kuru, O Ajmida, is dependent on you. O dear, preserve your fame and protect the sons of Pritha who are mere boys and who are affected with the troubles of exile.

sa: समस्तामर्जुनाद् विद्यां सात्यकिः क्षिप्रमाप्तवान्। शैनेयः समरे स्थाता बीजवत् प्रवपञ्छरान्॥
en: Satyaki very quickly obtained all knowledge (of the use of arms) from Arjuna and the son of Shini will stand on the field of battle and shoot arrows as (men) sow the seeds.

sa: कुम्भकर्णादयश्चेमे नग्नाः पतितमूर्धजाः। गच्छन्ति दक्षिणामाशां रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः॥
en: (I have also seen) Kumbhakarna and others stark naked, besmeared with blood and with their heads shaven, taking to the southern direction.

sa: प्रीतस्ततोऽस्य भगवान् देवदेवः पुरातनः। साक्षात् तं दर्शयामास सोऽदृश्योऽन्येन केनचित्॥
en: The ancient God of gods (viz., Hari), became highly pleased with the king on account of that sacrifice. Incapable of being seen by any one else, the great God appeared before his worshipper.

sa: स कदाचित् समुद्रान्ते विचरन् बलदर्पितः। अवाकिरशरशतैः समुद्रमिति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that, once on a time, as he was walking on the shores of the sea, proud of his power, he showered hundreds of arrows on thal vast receptacle of water.

sa: पराक्रमज्ञो रामस्य शठो दृष्टभयः पुरा। समुत्क्रान्तस्ततो मुक्तस्तावुभौ राक्षसौ हतौ॥
en: Wicked as I am, I was fully aware of his prowess having been frightened by him on a former occasion, and so I saved myself by escaping, but those two Raksasas were killed.

sa: वायुप्रकोपाद्भूतानि निरुच्छ्वासानि सर्वतः। संधिभिर्भिद्यमानैश्च काष्ठभूतानि जज्ञिरे॥
en: On account of the anger of the Wind-god their breath was completely obstructed, and the joints-as if pierced, became hard as wood.

sa: तं पश्य पुरुषव्याघ्रमादित्यतनयं विभो। स्वस्थानस्थं महाबाहो जहि शोकं नरर्षभ॥
en: See, O powerful one, that foremost of men, viz., the son of the Sum. He is in that place which is his own, O mighty-armed one. Kill this grief of yours, O king.

sa: स्विष्टकृद् भिषगावर्तः कपिलस्त्वं च वामनः। यज्ञो ध्रुवः पतङ्गश्च यज्ञसेनस्त्वमुच्यसे॥
en: You are the Creator, you are the father of the celestial physicians, you are (the sage) Kapila, and you are the Dwarf. You are Sacrifice embodied, you are Dhruva, you are called Yajnasena.

sa: वायोर्मूर्तिमतः पार्श्वे दिव्यमूर्तिसमन्वितम्। श्रिया परमया युक्तं सिद्धि परमिकां गतम्॥
en: He was sitting by the side of the god of wind in his embodied form. Indeed he was then in a celestial form gifted with great beauty, and had acquired with highest success.

sa: तथा मे नारदः प्राह व्यासश्च सुमहातपाः। नरनारायणावेतौ सम्भूतौ मनुजेष्विति॥
en: The celestial Rishi Narada told me this, as also Vyasa of austere penances. Even they have said to me that, Thyself and Arjuna are the old Rishis Narayana and Nara born among men.

sa: दाशा_पुत्रजं वीरं शयानं सत्यविक्रमम्। आरोप्याङ्के रुदन्त्येताश्चेदिराजवराङ्गनाः॥
en: Placing upon their laps and prostrate form of the heroic Dhrishtaketu of Dasharha race, those foremost of ladies, are crying in sorrow.

sa: वैदूर्यमणिचित्राणि प्रवालरुचिराणि च। अर्कस्फटिकशुभ्राणि वज्रसारोज्ज्वलानि च।॥
en: Decorated with Vaidurya-gems and with corals and with the species of white marble, called Arka and with the shining gems, called Vajrasara,

sa: शोणितोदकनिष्पन्दा काकगृध्रसमाकुला। प्रवृत्ता संयुगमुखे शस्त्रग्राहवती नदी॥
en: There issued out in the battle-field a river from weapons, having blood for its silent waters and infested with crows and vultures.

sa: स्वर्गेऽपि खलु रामस्य कुशलं दैवतैरहम्। प्रत्यादेशादभिहितं धारयिष्ये कथं बत॥
en: When in heaven, questioning me as to Rāma's welfare, the celestials, learning of his banishment to the woods, will tax me on this score, how shall I also bear that reproach of theirs?

sa: प्राप्तवानस्मि यल्लोके क्षत्रवंशोद्भवं यशः। वीरशब्दफलं चैव तेन संयुज्यतां भवान्॥
en: “The farne that I have gained in this world, and which is due to my being born in the Kshatriya order, the merit earned by me for being called a hero-is all yours.”

sa: प्राप्तवानस्मि यल्लोके सर्वर्णेष्वगहया। तदप्यथ च दास्यामि तेन संयुज्यतां भवान्॥
en: "The merit that I have earned in this world by my conduct towards all the castes, which can not be found fault with, that too I give you and may you earn that.

sa: उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भीष्मं बाष्पकण्ठोऽश्रुलोचनः। त्वां वयं हि समाश्रित्य संयुगे शत्रुसूदन॥
en: Made of gold, of exquisite workmanship and over-spread with an excellent coverlet. Then he thus spoke to Bhishma, with his palms folded, his voice choked in grief and his eyes bathed in tears.

sa: अप्यरेः श्येनवच्छिद्रं पश्येस्त्वं विपरिक्रमन्। विवदन् वाथवा तूष्णीं व्योम्नि वापरिशङ्कितः॥
en: Or be on the look out for the holes of your enemies like a hawk roaming about in the sky or you show your prowess and fight without any doubts in your mind.

sa: तिलसृष्टं न चाश्नीयात् तथास्यायुर्न रिष्यते॥ नाध्यापयेत् तथोच्छिष्टो नाधीयीत कदाचन।
en: One should never take his mcals without cating some sesame. One should never teach (the Vedas or any scriptures) at a time when he is impure. Nor should onc study while is impure.

sa: दर्शनीयं मृगाकीर्णं मनोहरमतीव च। नानाप्रकारैः शकुनैर्वल्गुभाषैरलंकृतम्॥
en: It is pleasing to the sight, and abounds in beasts, and is exceedingly romantic, and is adorned with various birds singing sweetly.

sa: भवत्वेष पतत्त्रीणामिंद्रोऽतिबलसत्त्ववान्। प्रसादः क्रियतामस्य देवराजस्य याचतः॥
en: Let there be an Indra of the winged creatures, endued with great strength. Be gracious to Indra who is suppliant to you."

sa: व्यभ्रमाकाशमाविश्य मांसशोणितभोजनाः। मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि खगाश्चक्रू रथं प्रति॥
en: And swarming under the cloudless welkin, birds feasting on flesh and gore began to gyrate at the right hand of the car.

sa: भीमदुन्दुभिहासाय भीमव्रतधराय च। उग्राय च नमो नित्यं नमोऽस्तु दशबाहवे॥
en: Salutations to you who laugh dreadfully and as loud as the beat of a drum, and who practise dreadful vows! Salutations for ever to you who are fierce, and who have ten arms.

sa: ततः पुनः समुदितं क्षत्रं समभवत्तदा। इमं चैवात्र वक्ष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम्॥
en: Thus it was that the Kshatriya race was again brought into existence all over the world. There is an old history in connection with this matter and I shall narrate it to you.

sa: व्यायच्छमानौ तौ वीरौ बाहुद्रविणशालिनौ॥ बहुत्वात्रिहतौ तत्र उभौ कृष्णस्य पश्यतः।
en: Gifted with might of arms and w’alth of energy, those two heroes acted with great courage. But as the odds were overwhelming, both of them were killed before the very eyes of Krishna.

sa: न तत्सदः सत्परिवत् सभा च सा प्राप्य यां न कुरुते सदा भयम्। धर्मतत्त्वमवगाह्य बुद्धिमान् योऽभ्युपैति स धुरंधरः पुमान्॥
en: That concourse of learned men engaged in the discussion of the ethics of both the Shrutis and the Smritis is not a good assembly,-indeed, that does not deserve to be called so,-entering which a wicked man is not stricken with fear. That men is the foremost of his sex, who having made a proper enquiry after righteousness acts according to the conclusions to which he arrives.

sa: अन्तर्वेद्यां ददद् वित्तं कामाननुभवन् प्रियान्। क्रीडन् स्त्रीभिर्निरातङ्कः प्रशाम्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, give away (wealth) in charity on the occasions of sacrifices; gratify every dear object of your desire; sport freely in the company of women, and enjoy peace.

sa: अग्रहस्तं विधुन्वंस्तु हस्ती हस्तमीवात्मनः। तिर्यगूज़ शरीरे च पातयित्वा शिरोधराम्॥
en: Moving the extremities of his hands like to the trunk of an elephant, variously altering the altitude of the neck above his frame, glancing a look awry, thus spoke he to his brother.

sa: ऊचुश्चैनमसम्भ्रान्ता न रोषं कर्तुमर्हसि। नैष धर्मः कृतयुगे यस्त्वं रोषमचीकृथाः॥
en: With cool heads, all of them said to Brihaspati,-You should not yield to anger. In this golden age, this anger to which you have yielded should not be the characteristic of any one.

sa: पराजयमशोचन्तः कृतचित्ताश्च विक्रमे। सर्वे सुनिश्चिता योद्धमुदग्रमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Without at all grieving for their defeat and firmly bent upon displaying their prowess, all of them, prepared for fight, became enthusiastic.

sa: तस्य पारिषदा दिव्या रूपैर्नानाविधैर्विभोः। वामना जटिला मुण्डा ह्रस्वग्रीवा महोदराः॥
en: That great one has for his companions, celestial beings of various forms, some of whom are dwarfs, some with matted locks, some with bald heads, some with short necks, some with large stomachs.

sa: उग्रायुधाय देवाय नमः सुरवराय च॥ नमोऽस्तु बहुरूपाय नमोऽस्तु बहुधन्विने।
en: Salutations to that deity whose weapons are terrible and who himself is the foremost of all gods, salutations to him whose semblances are various and who has got diverse bowmen as his attendants.

sa: वधार्थं पाण्डपुत्रस्य याचितां शक्तिमेव च॥ घटोत्कचे व्यंसयतः कस्त्वत्तः पापकृत्तमः।
en: The dart that had been begged (of Shakra as a boon) by Karna for the destruction of Arjuna, was baffled by you through Ghatotkacha! Who is there that is more sinful than you?

sa: सम्भ्रान्तनागाश्वरथे मुहूर्ते महाक्षये सादिपदातियूनाम्। महारथैः सम्परिवार्यमाणो ददर्श भीष्मः कपिराजकेतुम्॥
en: Then when horsemen and foot soldiers were falling fast, and elephants, horses and cars were flying away in fear, Bhishma surrounded by many great car-warriors got a sight of the ape-mannered warrior (Arjuna).
